connector.name: RASON
connector.registryDescription: Build, solve, and analyze RASON optimization, simulation, data science, and decision models
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package rason-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the frontlinesystems account. Treat it as community software and read the source before granting access to anything sensitive.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: RASON_BEARER_TOKEN
env.description: RASON API bearer token. Required for model management, solving, and diagnostics. Obtain at https://rason.com/.

env.name: RASON_SERVER_URL
env.description: Base URL of the RASON REST API. /api is appended automatically.

env.name: RASON_RESULT_ARRAY_LIMIT
env.description: Maximum array/dataFrame rows before solver results are summarized.

env.name: RASON_RESULT_SIZE_LIMIT
env.description: Maximum solve-result size (in characters) before truncation.
